title: Node streaming CSV export
context: Streams a large orders table to CSV files. Fields may contain commas, quotes, CR and LF and must be quoted per RFC 4180 (embedded quotes doubled). exportOrders must respect write-stream backpressure, reject if the export fails, and resolve only after all data has been flushed to the file. exportAll resolves with every written path once all exports have finished.
code: for await (const row of db.iterate("SELECT id, customer, total_cents, note FROM orders")) {

expected.why: replace without the g flag doubles only the first quote, producing invalid CSV for fields with several quotes
the drain promise is not awaited, so backpressure is ignored and the whole table is buffered in memory
the error is logged and swallowed, so exportOrders resolves as if the export succeeded
returns before the stream has emitted finish, so callers may read a file that is not fully flushed; await once(out, "finish") first
forEach does not wait for async callbacks, so exportAll returns an empty array before any export has finished
